ideas.name: Crude Oil Order Imbalance Impact
ideas.claim: The paper estimates permanent and temporary price impacts of order imbalances in NYMEX crude oil futures on roll and non-roll days.
ideas.quote: For the front contract, the permanent price impact for sell imbalance on roll days is 0.040 versus .041 on non-roll days (p-value of difference=0.57).
ideas.mechanism: FLOW: price impact of signed order imbalance

rules.filters: Roll and non-roll days analyzed separately

ideas.claimed_result: Estimated front-contract permanent price impact for sell imbalance was 0.040 on roll days and 0.041 on non-roll days; the reported difference had a p-value of 0.57. The detailed trade data covered March 2008 through February 2009.
required_data: NYMEX crude oil futures transaction prices
